elements.description: 3-riser (EQ/EQ/EQ over 0.50m rise) step up from ครัว/แม่บ้าน (kitchen) level +0.60 to ซักล้าง (laundry) level +0.50 -- wait, laundry finish level is LOWER than kitchen per A-04/A-06 (+0.50 vs +0.60); tread finish 8x8" ceramic tile, aluminium nose

warnings: ST.2 architecture mark is a distinct small stair from the structural sheets' 'ST2' pedestal-column note in S-09/S-11/S-12 title (ระดับชั้นที่1-ชานพัก) -- see A-21/A-22 warning for the cross-discipline mark clash between architecture's ST.1/ST.2/ST.3 and structural's single ST2 (referring to the main L-shaped stair, called ST.3 in architecture).
